topics.name: MeritCore Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for identity-bound merit timelines, points, Tier evidence, recommendations/trust and weekly reporting periods.

semantics.identity_rule: Identity, Project, merit evidence, recommendation, point result and Tier identities/results remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: Review/accept/reject/recommend operations invoke separate authorized canonical operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing MeritCore history grants no mutation/recommendation authority.
semantics.trace_rule: Every derived point/Tier/reporting view retains exact evidence/policy refs.
semantics.privacy_rule: Merit visibility follows applicable IAM/privacy policy.
semantics.projection_rule: CV/portfolio-style presentation is derived and never becomes the source Merit record.

invariants.rule: MeritCore derives human competence/trust history from explicit identity-bound Project evidence; identities, evidence, recommendations, points, Tier and broker relevance remain separate semantic dimensions.

hard_gates.condition: identity histories merged visually as one semantic record
